title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Meadowbrook Physical Therapy under your health plan for services provided on July 16, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Because you are currently receiving inpatient care, this request was handled as an expedited concurrent review.

We determined that the continued acute inpatient stay does not meet our criteria for medical necessity under guideline CAL-RAD-109. The information we received does not support the need for this service at this time. Reason code: CO-50.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $30,954.16 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $30,954.16.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Calloway Health Network, Appeals Unit, PO Box 24553, Savannah, GA 31401. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-2305.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
